style_profile.name: Cozy Minimalist Iced Latte Routine
style_profile.hook_strategy: Clean aesthetic kitchen counter setting a ribbed glass tumbler down with an instant crisp clink sound and minimalist lowercase text 'morning coffee', followed by fast tactile box tearing to trigger cozy aesthetic satisfaction.
style_profile.preferred_font_layout: Delicate lowercase sans-serif centered in middle third with clean white tone, no heavy background badge.
transition_rules: Rapid jump cuts synced to physical tactile interaction (box tear, pod opening, milk pour, straw stir)
High-key airy white lighting with soft focus transition between action beats
